snippet.title: Pray Your God! — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You will choose a number. I will choose one too. Should your god make them agree, heaven removes me in ways I would rather not describe.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5116850/

Found a cult. Name it, name your followers, choose two sacred colours, and decide how large a flock to bring along. Ten, if you like a brisk service. A million, if you intend to be remembered.

Then you pray. You choose a number, one of a hundred; the Inquisitor chooses one too, after you, always after you, with a die that does not cheat. Miss, and a follower is quietly removed from the register, with a footnote.

Guess right and your god finally answers, by removing the Inquisitor from the premises. There are 16 ways for this to happen, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, and you do not get to choose which one you get.

The die is honest. That is the joke.

— 16 endings, drawn and never chosen
— 36 achievements, most of them awarded for things that went badly
— A new cult every two to four minutes
— An Inquisitor with over fifty ways of telling you no
— A chiptune organ that takes all of this far too seriously

Coming soon to Steam for Windows.

▶ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5116850/
▶ Site: https://www.creedr.com/
▶ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/creedr.com
▶ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@creedrstudios
▶ X: https://x.com/CreedrStudios
